sections.heading: Keyboard Shortcuts
sections.intro: Keyboard shortcuts untuk mempercepat navigasi dan editing di Scenario Studio Canvas.

steps.title: Navigasi Antar Step
steps.desc: Enter — Lanjut ke step berikutnya; Esc — Tutup canvas; Alt + ← — Kembali ke step sebelumnya

steps.title: Canvas & Viewport
steps.desc: Space + Drag — Pan; Scroll — Zoom; Ctrl + - — Zoom out; Ctrl + = — Zoom in; Ctrl + 0 — Reset zoom

steps.title: Node Operations
steps.desc: Klik — Pilih node; Shift + Klik — Multi-select; Klik + Drag — Pindahkan; Delete — Hapus; Klik kanan — Context menu

steps.title: Undo / Redo
steps.desc: Ctrl + Z — Undo; Ctrl + Shift + Z — Redo; Ctrl + Y — Redo

steps.title: Clipboard
steps.desc: Ctrl + C — Copy; Ctrl + X — Cut; Ctrl + V — Paste
